info.description: The course provides students with knowledge about grammar, pronunciation, language functions so that they will be able to communicate and discuss in different topics: new media, language, work and fun, deception, global cooperation, personal space, alternative thinking, change, energy, size and scale and acquire language proficiency at level C1.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Know some grammatical points, sentence patterns and some aspects of pronunciation used in topics related to new media, language, work and fun, deception, global cooperation, personal space, alternative thinking, change, energy, size and scale
Understand some common functional languages in communication with language proficiency at level C1
Identify and evaluate stress, intonation, and language use of speakers. Then, they can communicate effectively in specific contexts
Self-assess their understanding and their proficiency in each lesson. Then, they can adjust themselves to improve their communication skills during the learning process
